review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample (1.2, 1.5, 1.6, 2.0, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 4.7, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.6, 5.7, 5.10, 6.1): 54 README locators checked in 14 sources (Schoof, Dieulefait-Pacetti, Snowden, Khare-Wintenberger preprint and Annals, Odlyzko survey with page 122 rendered, Fontaine, Khare, Moon-Taguchi, Mazur, Jones, Fesenko-Vostokov, Ghitza-Yamauchi, Faber), with Poitou's DPP expose also read for the 1.5 remark. Adversarial pass with computed values: Poitou bound and all 13 rows of the 1.9 degree table recomputed numerically, the Minkowski thresholds, the char-2/char-3 different bounds and their sharp examples, the five field criteria, and the 5.10 Serre-weight cases checked against AlgebraicModularFormsAndSerreWeights 4.3. Automatic checks all passed; depcheck 211 roadmaps, 2271 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean gives only the 13 sorry warnings; 31 signatures compared with the README. Consumer citations checked at the open heads of SerreModularityByCompatibleSystems and ClassicalSerreModularity. Corrections: incomplete notes on later users (S3 needs 5.6, S4 needs 5.9; 5.0d and 5.1 have further users) and two over-broad sentences in the description. Format note: the code-font name RankTwoOrdinaryEndpoints is declared nowhere. Human question: licence of the Annals PDF host.
